name: pass-strength-inline-indicator
title: Password Strength Inline
blurb: Password input with border color strength indicator and hover requirements card.
description: A password form where the input border changes color based on strength, with requirements accessed via an info icon that opens a hover card.
use_when: When strength feedback should be subtle and integrated directly into the input border.
avoid_when: When separate strength bars or dots are needed or when inline color indicators might be unclear.
a11y: Password input properly labeled, info icon triggers hover card, requirements have aria-label.
